notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (used free credits, did simple chat test).

Quick summary:
- SMB customer (helpdesk SaaS) focused on reducing agent handle time and surfacing docs to agents via embeddings + reranking.
- Currently evaluating hosted API; primary ask: "What model should we pick for best balance of accuracy vs token cost?" — specifically mentioned Llama 2 / Llama 3 variants, Mistral 7B/8x, and Qwen series.

Customer constraints / goals:
- Latency target: 150-300ms per interactive response for agent UI (p95 goal but willing to accept 400ms for heavy context).
- Throughput: peak ~30 rps during support surges, avg 5-8 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: high — startup budget, wants predictable cost and easy scaling.
- Quality needs: accurate retrieval reranking + short multi-turn summaries (2-5 turns). Prioritizes fewer hallucinations over extremely creative output.
- Data residency: US only (not strict), happy w/ public cloud region us-east/us-west.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance and audit logs.

Model selection discussion (notes from 2026-02-24 call):
- Customer asked: "Llama3-small vs Mistral: which is cheaper and still reliable for reranking/embeds?"
- SE (Ravi): recommended hosted API try Mistral-7B-v2 for initial POC (good quality/cost), fallback to Llama3 medium for more conservative summaries. Mentioned Qwen-7B as a possible low-cost baseline but noted fewer community quality benchmarks for their task.
- Customer concerned about token pricing and need for token-level cost breakdown (asked for example TCO estimates per 10k conversations).
- Discussed Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching windows for throughput peaks and prefix caching for recurring prompts. Customer liked autosuggest for batching.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-15: self-serve signup, trial credits used.
- 2026-02-18: inbound questionnaire completed (latency/throughput + security checklist).
- 2026-02-24: discovery call (Maya + Ravi) — demo of hosted API + sample reranking flow. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-24_verdigris_demo.
- 2026-03-05: follow-up email with cost examples and quickstart repo link. Gmail thread id thread-CA+vd3Vg-verdigris-20260225.
- 2026-03-10: customer replied with evaluation dataset and asked for targeted recommendations per model (requested side-by-side eval on their data).

POC plan agreed (lightweight):
- Provide 50k token credit + onboarding guide.
- Redwood to run 3-model A/B: Mistral-7B, Llama3-medium, Qwen-7B on their sample reranking + summary prompt set.
- Measure: rerank accuracy (MRR), hallucination rate (manual spot-check), latency p95, token cost per 1k conversations.
- Timeline: 2-week POC after credits applied.

Open questions / asks from customer:
- Clear pricing matrix comparing expected cost for Mistral vs Llama vs Qwen for their expected token volumes.
- Guidance on quantized/fast variants for lower cost and any expected quality delta.
- Can Redwood provide auto-fallback policy config examples (e.g., route to cheaper model when capacity/cost threshold hit)?

Sales cues / talk tracks to use:
- Emphasize hosted API self-serve path + credits to validate cost model quickly.
- Show Redwood Optimize recommendations and simulated cost savings from caching + batching.
- Provide concrete A/B evaluation plan and offer to run the three-model job if they share evaluation dataset (customer offered to upload to Drive).

Next steps (short):
- Send POC credit grant + detailed pricing sheet comparing model-specific per-token pricing and estimated monthly bill at their projected usage (Maya) — due 2026-03-12.
- SE to prepare side-by-side eval pipeline and recommended config file for auto-routing (Ravi) — initial draft 2026-03-14.
- Customer to confirm dataset upload to shared Drive link and scheduled time for kickoff call (they prefer 2026-03-17).

Direct quote from customer: "We need to see the dollars per seat — if Mistral gives us 60-70% of the quality at half the token cost, that's compelling."

Internal notes:
- Likely SMB conversion if POC shows clear cost delta w/out major quality drop.
- Watch for budget freeze mid-Q2; prioritize fast win and low-effort evaluation.
- Possible upsell path: Redwood Optimize + longer retention/logging once SOC2/SAML box is ticked.
